llm_response.reason: The website displays common scam traits: a mismatch between domain/branding (Daan Ibrahim) and merchandise (claims to sell Alex Mill products), ambiguous or missing company data, fake urgency/sale wording, and unclear or missing pricing. No legitimate contact methods are visible. External community feedback (e.g., Facebook group) clearly identifies it as a scam. These match multiple characteristics of scam sites, including fake brands, urgency tactics, and nonexistent business legitimacy.
